maddeler.e:
اقتويا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَوَيَا (iqtawayā) /iq.ta.wa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اُقْتُوِيَا (uqtuwiyā) /uq.tu.wi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اِقْتَوِيَا (iqtawiyā) /iq.ta.wi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
